const BASE_URL=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||"/api";const getAuthHeader=()=>{const token=localStorage.getItem("bookhaven_token");return token?{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}:{};};const handleResponse=async res=>{const data=await res.json();if(!res.ok)throw new Error(data.error||"Request failed");return data;};export const api={// Auth
